name: MonarchTimesheetDiff
title: TimesheetDiff
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column and FlowRow with MonarchBadge, androidx.compose.material3.Text with tabular figures (MonarchTabularNumberStyle) and android.icu.text.MeasureFormat
summary: What changed between two versions of a timesheet: added, removed and changed entries, each named in words with its effect on the time, and a totals line.
whenToUse: For a resubmitted or corrected timesheet, an approval review or an audit view, where the reviewer needs to see what moved and how much time it adds or removes.
whenNotToUse: For the timesheet itself use a list or a table of entries. For a general record of changes use MonarchActivityTimeline.
api: @Composable fun MonarchTimesheetDiff(diff: MonarchTimesheetDiffResult, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, subtitle: String? = null, showTotals: Boolean = true, showBillable: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchTimesheetDiffLabels = MonarchTimesheetDiffLabels())

@Composable fun MonarchTimesheetDiff(before: List<MonarchTimesheetDiffEntry>, after: List<MonarchTimesheetDiffEntry>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, subtitle: String? = null, showTotals: Boolean = true, showBillable: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchTimesheetDiffLabels = MonarchTimesheetDiffLabels())
class MonarchTimesheetDiffEntry(id: String, date: Long, minutes: Int, project: String? = null, activity: String? = null, task: String? = null, billable: Boolean? = null, note: String? = null)

class MonarchTimesheetDiffResult(added: List<MonarchTimesheetDiffEntry> = emptyList(), removed: List<MonarchTimesheetDiffEntry> = emptyList(), changed: List<MonarchTimesheetDiffChange> = emptyList()) { val isEmpty: Boolean; val totals: MonarchTimesheetDiffTotals; companion object { fun between(before: List<MonarchTimesheetDiffEntry>, after: List<MonarchTimesheetDiffEntry>): MonarchTimesheetDiffResult } }
class MonarchTimesheetDiffChange(id: String, fields: List<String>, before: MonarchTimesheetDiffEntry, after: MonarchTimesheetDiffEntry)
object MonarchTimesheetDiffFields { const val DATE, MINUTES, PROJECT, ACTIVITY, TASK, BILLABLE, NOTE, START, END: String }

class MonarchTimesheetDiffLabels(title: String? = null, added: String? = null, removed: String? = null, changed: ((List<String>) -> String)? = null, fields: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(), before: String? = null, after: String? = null, noProject: String? = null, nonBillable: String? = null, noChanges: String? = null, delta: ((Int) -> String)? = null, totals: ((String, String?) -> String)? = null, entry: ((MonarchTimesheetDiffEntry) -> String)? = null)

options.name: diff
options.description: The entries added, removed and changed, when the product computes the difference itself.

options.name: before, after
options.description: The two versions; entries are matched by id and compared on date, minutes, project, activity, task, billable and note.

options.name: subtitle
options.description: Quiet text after the heading, such as "since version 3".

options.name: showBillable
options.description: Adds the billable change to the totals line. Turn it off when billing does not apply.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, the field names, the delta and totals formats, and the line of an entry (the web's renderEntry, as text).

states.name: added
states.description: A success-tinted line with a success bar at the start edge, an "Added" badge, the time gained and the entry.

states.name: removed
states.description: A danger-tinted line with a "Removed" badge, the time lost and the entry struck through in the muted color.

states.name: changed
states.description: A warning-tinted line with a "Changed time, project" badge, the old line struck through above the new one, and the change of time when there is one.

appearance: Each line is tinted with its tone's subtle color and has a bar in the tone's solid color at the start edge; the kind is a MonarchBadge in the same tone and the change of time uses the tone's strong color. Entry text is the default text color; struck-through lines use the muted color. High contrast themes use their stronger tone roles.
platformNotes: The parity map named a LazyColumn; the diff is a plain Column so that it can sit inside a card or a scrolling review screen (a lazy list there needs a fixed height), and a review has tens of changes. The web takes ISO date strings; here the day is epoch milliseconds of its UTC midnight, as in the Material 3 date picker, shown in UTC. The web's renderEntry returns any content; here labels.entry returns the line as text, which is also what TalkBack reads. The web's open-ended field names are strings, with MonarchTimesheetDiffFields for the built-in ones. The web's headingLevel is heading semantics. Visible durations ("1h 30m") follow the web's compact form and are not localised; TalkBack reads them in words in the user's locale through ICU MeasureFormat. The kind is a MonarchBadge (the plan's badge dependency); digits use MonarchTabularNumberStyle. iOS builds the same component with the same name.
accessibility: Each line is one element read in words: "Removed, minus 45 minutes, Mon, Jan 12, 45 minutes, Pulse, non-billable"; a changed entry reads "Before:" and "After:" before its two lines.
Durations and the totals are read in words in the user's locale ("1 hour, 30 minutes", "Total plus 15 minutes · billable plus 1 hour").
The kind is a word in a badge as well as a color; a removed entry and the old line of a changed one are struck through.
Text wraps and scales with the font size setting.
edgeCases: An empty or missing project is shown as "No project".
billable null counts as billable in the totals, as on the web; only false is non-billable.
A changed entry whose time did not change shows no change of time.
A missing value and an empty one are different, so null to "" is a change.
Two dates on the same UTC day are the same date.
Field names neither labels.fields nor the built-in names know are shown by their raw name.
Order: added, then removed, then changed, each in the order of its version.
